venues.name: Le Stanze
venues.address: Via del Borgo di San Pietro 1a

sources.use_review_basis: Current first-party Bere menu at owner AngoloB. Exact existing static/OSM name, phone, domain and Via Giuseppe Garibaldi 7c. Only named EUR drinks with one amount are included: seven Signatures, five Analcolici and two explicitly labelled 1.5-litre wines. Other wine rows lack serving size and are held. No fee inferred.

Current first-party Distillati page and exact published static Le Stanze venue. Owner says civic 1; same OSM node has addr:housenumber 1a and contact:housenumber 1, exact owner website and phone, so both refer to the same venue. Only 95 named Singolo spirit prices are included, with volume unknown. The second Cocktail column lacks recipe/mixer semantics and is held. No fee inferred.
